text:
leah: caught a tenant saw oscillating fallbacks overnight. digging shows clients are optimistic about renewals because last_update moves before commit finishes. we need a small, low-risk schema tweak to signal commit guarantees.
omar: we shouldn't force synchronous client confirms (too chatty). what about a two-token approach: `staging_token` issued immediately when renew starts, then `active_token` once control-plane durably commits. clients accept staging_token only for N seconds (grace window) and otherwise re-resolve.
tasha: nice. that avoids big GC changes. add `commit_epoch_ms` + `lease_seq` so clients can compare monotonic seqs. also include `grace_window_ms`.
leah: sample payload idea (API canonical ints): {lease_seq: "104", commit_epoch_ms: "1715000000000", staging_ttl_ms: "12000", grace_window_ms: "3000", issuer: "autoscaler"} but we'll put it all inside one json text blob in the docs.
omar: client policy: if seen staging_token && now < commit_epoch_ms + grace_window_ms then allow local serve; if lease_seq mismatches then force resolve. default grace_window 3s.
tasha: acceptance: metrics for staging_token_uses, lease_seq_mismatch_rate, and no-regression in eviction rate. also add e2e chaos test with 2s commit delay.
build-bot: build queued for branch `dual-lease-token` (CI #1309).
leah: I'll open RFC PR with schema + small client lib helpers. thanks.
